title: Remove or justify PushPipeline.pushCompletion — OutboxProcessor never calls it
why: OutboxProcessor's _dispatch switch has no case for OutboxEntityKind.completion — completions are handled exclusively via pushCompletionsBatch, consistent with the class doc's own warning ('Never call [pushCompletion] in a loop — that defeats the batching'). A repo-wide grep for `.pushCompletion(` shows the only caller of PushPipeline's (non-gateway) pushCompletion is test code calling it directly; production code never reaches it through the drain path. It's a fully implemented, individually tested, but currently unreachable interface method — dead surface area that invites drift (e.g. a future fix applied to pushCompletionsBatch but not mirrored here, or a future caller reintroducing the exact N-round-trip problem batching was built to eliminate).
recommendation: Either delete pushCompletion from PushPipeline (and its implementation/tests) or add a doc comment on the interface method naming its actual sanctioned caller/purpose so the next reader doesn't mistake it for reachable code.
acceptance_criteria: Grep confirms either the method is removed (and OutboxPushPipeline/tests updated) or a doc comment states its real caller.
